statement: Samsung is seeking up to a 20% 3Q26 DRAM contract price increase and suppliers have cut quote validity to 72 hours amid rapid price escalation.
why: Aggressive DRAM price hikes and 72-hour quotes reflect acute memory supply tightness driven by AI demand.

impact.mechanism: Tight, rapidly repricing memory raises AI-server bill of materials and gates supply.

evidence.excerpt: up to a 20% increase in 3Q26 DRAM contract pricing

dispersion: conflicting same-key reports: statement/trend changed (trend rising -> rising); sources: The Korea Herald, VersaLogic Supply Chain Brief
